about.label: THE PERSON
about.bio_1: I'm Inefable Koumba, a Software Developer and Technical Lead based in Brazzaville, Republic of the Congo. I work as the Lead Developer at FRANZER OÜ building enterprise software and payment solutions that serve real businesses across Africa and beyond.
about.bio_2: My work spans the full stack — from designing microservices architectures and high-throughput backends in Go to crafting pixel-perfect mobile interfaces with Flutter and React Native. I care deeply about both engineering quality and the human experience on the other side of the screen.
about.bio_3_suffix: at Brigham Young University – Idaho, building on a foundation in Systems & Network Administration from ESGAE in Brazzaville.

experience.desc: Architectural decisions, backend high-throughput integrations & UI/UX engineering for enterprise applications and payment solutions.
End-to-end design, full-stack development, and cloud infrastructure management for proprietary mobile and web applications (UI/UX, frontend, backend & DevOps).
Invoice management platform (50%+ time savings), POS deployments for Total Energies & PUMA, DOMS PSS 5000 configuration.
Built sandweiler.lu & berdorf.lu — high-fidelity municipal sites with seamless CMS integration.
